description: Extract a component's pin/pad table from a datasheet PDF as verifiable, provenance-tracked evidence — not raw PDF text to re-interpret. Returns a PinoutEvidence document (contract pinout_evidence_v1): the canonical pins and special pads with names/types/functions. It also RESOLVES THE PACKAGE from the terminals — `package.family`, `package.variant` (e.g. SOT-223, TQFP-32) and `package.pin_count` — so use this tool to answer package-variant and pin-count questions, not extract_package_dimensions (mechanical geometry) or decode_part_number (ordering codes). A review-state flags when the result must be human-checked (e.g. no pins recovered, or the module raised warnings). Prefer this over reading the PDF yourself; trust `review.required` before acting. Runs DatasheetVend Fast Extraction: a page scout routes targeted reads of the pin tables, cross-checked against the package drawing where the document prints one, usually in seconds; `engine` names the engine on every result. If Fast Extraction cannot extract the pinout, the slower deep engine re-runs pinout alone (engine.runtime is then `monolith_rescue`; a rescue can take several minutes, so set a client timeout of 10 minutes). Only if that also fails does it come back as an error with the reason.

documentPath.description: https:// URL to the datasheet PDF. The remote /api/mcp endpoint accepts ONLY https:// URLs (it downloads them); a local filesystem path works solely in local stdio mode (npm run mcp:serve).

packageSelection.description: Optional package/variant (e.g. 'LQFP48') when the datasheet lists more than one; Fast Extraction reads that package's pin column.

partName.description: Optional part number / MPN to disambiguate a datasheet that covers several parts.

name: datasheetvend_extract_pinout

documentRef.description: Echo of the documentPath/URL that was extracted

duration_ms.description: Wall time of the extraction in milliseconds

failed_modules.description: Modules that came back without a result: Fast Extraction could not extract them, and neither could the per-module deep-engine rescue where one was attempted

lanes.description: How each module was answered, where the engine recorded it

lane.description: deterministic_primary, worker_with_deterministic_brain, deterministic_recovery, worker_only, or monolith_rescue

name.description: The engine the extraction started on: always "fast_extraction" (runtime says what answered)

runtime.description: The runtime that answered: the Fast Extraction runtime, or "monolith_rescue" when the deep engine re-ran this module; null when no engine could run

evidence.description: The pinout module's canonical output: component, package (family/variant/pin_count), pins[] with capability mappings, special_pads[], enriched_fields, normalized_output, engineering_summary, warnings.

required.description: Whether human review is required before CAD integration

title: Extract datasheet pinout
